text: Measured T4transport sinkhornD default p=2: squared scaled spatiotemporal ground cost, distance sqrt(sum(plan*cost)), similarity 1/(1+distance); lambda is entropy scale. At lambda .01 default 496 iterations yields 0.948732031806375 versus independent converged primal oracle 0.9487302525140882; fixed 1e-7 gate fails and remains a recorded intentional solver divergence, not widened. Native log-domain solver admits only stated marginal tolerance; independent primal and analytic two-point/Dirac cases qualify it. Added only igraph 2.3.1 to the reference lock for exported R MultiMatch; every preexisting package record unchanged.
